Arc Floor Lamp

A single bent steel tube weighted at the foot, so it leans over a seat from a metre and a half away and stays exactly where you put it.

$690

Finish

Free shipping over $250 · 30-day returns, postage paid · Nothing on this site can actually be purchased.

Reaches over a sofa without standing in front of it.

The arc is bent from one 22 mm tube — no joints, no visible fixings. The base is a solid steel disc heavy enough that the lamp does not need to be anchored, which means it also does not need a floor plate you have to work around.

Care. Wipe with a damp cloth. The base will patina at the edges; this is expected.
